limitations: One case with three paired trials cannot satisfy the unchanged thirty-case minimum.

Environment evidence establishes bound execution eligibility; it is not complete transitive dependency or live daemon state attestation.

Production initial-state capture, broad policy/long-task/memory qualification, and full statistical/cost guardrails remain open.
